info.name: Coffee Field OS
info.description:
SPX Coffee Field OS REST API (`/api/v1`).

1. Select the Local environment.
2. Run **Auth → Login as SPX principal** to store `accessToken`.
3. Seed logins all use password `Password123!`.

Role notes: revenue ledger is `spx_principal` only. Silva cannot list raw field tickets.
